insertText.text: Native, editable PPTX decks from Go, zero dependencies
Stat tiles and a shape-drawn bar chart
of shapes rendered natively (editable in Slides and PowerPoint)
external dependencies beyond the Go standard library
design grid: position shapes like CSS pixels
rounded rects, ellipses, connectors with arrows
multi-paragraph rich text with per-run styling

d := deck.New()
s := d.Slide()
deck.Title(s, "Hello")
deck.Tile(s, 80, 180, 340, 150, "42", "the answer", deck.BLUE50, deck.BLUE7, 40)
d.Save("out.pptx")
